name: Construction scaffold
description: How a 2 × 2 building site looks once builders are at work: poles, ledgers, plank decks, ladder and a half-built core. The game shows scaffolding only after the first work and adds dust while builders work; it still draws it as simple lines until a variant is approved.

variants.name: First lift (up to 33 %)
variants.notes: Low stone courses, one lift, materials stacked beside it.

variants.name: Second lift (34–66 %)
variants.notes: Recommended look: lashed round poles and plank decks on the visible faces.

variants.name: Third lift (67–99 %)
variants.notes: Tallest stage before the finished building replaces it.

variants.name: Timber frame, sawn poles
variants.notes: Alternative for wooden buildings: squared poles around a timber frame.
